seoTitle: Benefits of datixxia™ — Practical economic insights
seoDescription: How banks, chambers of commerce, accountants, forecasters, universities and traders use datixxia™ procurement intelligence and 4-year forecasts.

hero.label: Benefits
hero.title: Benefits of Using datixxia™
hero.lead: Practical economic insights from published contract awards — understand market activity and spot potential opportunities for your organisation.

pillars.title: International sources, focused platform coverage
pillars.text: datixxia™ draws on historical records and incoming public contract award notices from international sources. Initial platform coverage focuses on France, the United Kingdom and Belgium, with additional countries to follow progressively. The depth of analysis depends on the available records.

pillars.title: Proprietary calculations for practical insights
pillars.text: Our analytical metrics help users examine market activity, compare changes across sectors and suppliers, and explore opportunity signals. Where reliable contract dates and durations are available, they also provide context for commitments extending into future periods.

pillars.title: Built for a range of organisations
pillars.text: Businesses of different sizes, researchers, journalists and public bodies can use datixxia™ to explore the markets covered by the platform and bring evidence from public contract awards to their work:

audiences.label: Who benefits
audiences.lead: Different organisations ask different questions of economic data. datixxia™ helps them explore public contract awards, understand changes in market activity and bring additional evidence to business planning, research and analysis.

cards.title: Accounting firms
cards.text: Accounting firms can use datixxia™ to add market context to conversations with corporate clients: examine award activity across relevant sectors and suppliers, explore potential opportunities and support clients’ business planning.

cards.title: Banks & insurance
cards.text: Banks and insurance companies can explore award activity to better understand the sectors their clients operate in. Patterns in recorded awards offer additional context that complements financial statements, risk assessments and other professional analysis.

cards.title: Chambers of commerce
cards.text: Chambers of commerce can examine procurement activity across available locations and sectors — supporting member briefings, identifying areas for further research and informing discussions about business development and supply-chain opportunities.

cards.title: Economic forecasters
cards.text: Economic forecasters can explore datixxia™ alongside other sources to investigate procurement trends and their relationship with wider economic developments. Historical awards provide context, while available contract periods offer evidence of commitments extending into the future.

cards.title: Universities & research centers
cards.text: Universities, research centres and business schools can explore public procurement through practical teaching and research — comparing sectors, examining supplier activity and learning to assess data coverage, quality and limitations.

wide.title: Analysts & investment researchers
wide.text: Analysts can examine how recorded award activity changes across sectors and suppliers, identifying patterns that merit closer investigation. For investment researchers, these findings contribute to a broader assessment alongside financial accounts and other market information. Award activity alone does not establish profitability, company valuation or future investment returns.

cta.text: Practical economic insights from published public contract awards — see what datixxia™ can do for your organisation.
